intro.text: A game played in Kingseat in which balls are thrown through floating rings, usually with bets riding on it.

description.text: A triple bet is three times the stake, but betting triple downed means cubing it.

One evening on the Night Barges, December, pretending to flirt, joined Will Kartov and his friends at a game, and he explained the rules. She bet triple downed when she meant triple bets, and Flint had to step in to get her out of it.
